subject.title: fix(memory-core): honor private-network settings for OpenAI-compatible embeddings

question: Should configured OpenAI-compatible memory embeddings use omitted policy for exact configured-origin trust, explicit false to deny that trust and local probing, and explicit true for broader private-network access?
rationale: Source inspection and proof establish that the implementation consistently enforces this contract, but they cannot determine whether maintainers intend explicit false to break previously working configured-private-endpoint setups.

options.title: Approve three-state contract
options.body: Land the provider-level omitted/false/true behavior as documented and proven by the PR.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in only
options.body: Remove omitted exact-origin trust so every private embedding endpoint requires explicit true.

options.title: Preserve explicit-false compatibility
options.body: Do not let false disable configured-origin trust until an upgrade path or separate strict mode is defined.

recommendation.title: Approve three-state contract
recommendation.body: Land the provider-level omitted/false/true behavior as documented and proven by the PR.
